Fastmail website, 2020

Fastmail’s 2020 home page: a woman with long legs relaxes at a laptop on a balcony full of plants, in a flat yellow hero with a curved lower edge.

The live Fastmail site has changed since this 2020 capture.

Observed

  • A dark navy bar holds the logo and navigation; a square blue “Sign up” button sits at the right.
  • The hero is a flat pale yellow field whose lower edge is a wide convex curve.
  • The heading “Email you can feel good about” is bold dark grey sans-serif; a square-cornered blue button reads “Try it free for 30 days”.
  • On the right, a woman with brown skin and long black hair sits with crossed legs in a white chair, holding a cup beside a pink laptop. Her shoes lie on the floor below.
  • Potted plants in pink and blue pots, a pale yellow city skyline, and trees surround her; some leaves and pots have a fine grain.

Why it belongs

The page takes the style’s plants, pastel field, and relaxed long-limbed figure and gives it a natural skin tone, a variant common after 2019.

Borrow

End the hero color field with one wide convex curve instead of a straight edge.
